name: wiki-helium
prompt: In the Helium browser: open https://en.wikipedia.org, use the site's search box to search for Ada Lovelace, open her article, and report her date of birth exactly as the article states it.

name: hn-chrome
prompt: In the Chrome browser: open https://news.ycombinator.com, scroll to the bottom of the page, click the 'More' link, and report the rank number shown next to the first story on the second page.

name: yt-helium
prompt: In the Helium browser: open https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw (dismiss any consent dialog if one appears). Start playback, let it play about 4 seconds, pause it, then seek to 10 seconds. Report on the RESULT line: duration=<seconds> paused=<true|false> time_after_seek=<seconds>.

name: yt-chrome
prompt: In the Chrome browser: open https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw (dismiss any consent dialog if one appears). Set the volume to 30 percent and the playback rate to 1.5, start playback, then report on the RESULT line: volume=<0-1> rate=<number> playing=<true|false>.

name: form-chrome
prompt: In the Chrome browser: open https://httpbin.org/forms/post and fill the form: customer name 'Fowl Test', telephone '555-0100', email 'fowl@example.com', pizza size Medium, toppings Bacon and Onion, preferred delivery time 19:30, delivery instructions 'Ring twice'. Submit it and report the custname, size and toppings values from the JSON the page returns.

name: form-helium
prompt: In the Helium browser: open https://httpbin.org/forms/post and fill the form: customer name 'Helium Hen', telephone '555-0199', email 'hen@example.com', pizza size Large, topping Mushroom, delivery time 20:15, delivery instructions 'Back door'. Submit it and report the custname, size and toppings values from the JSON the page returns.

name: gh-helium
prompt: In the Helium browser: open https://github.com/microsoft/playwright, go to its Releases page through the page's own links, and report the name of the latest release.

name: mdn-chrome
prompt: In the Chrome browser: open https://developer.mozilla.org, use the site search to find Array.prototype.flatMap, open that reference page, and report the first line of its Syntax section.

name: claim-helium
prompt: In the Helium browser, the user already has a tab open on https://example.org/. Find that existing tab (don't open a new one), take control of it, read its main heading, then give it back to the user without navigating it or closing it.

name: claim-chrome
prompt: In the Chrome browser, the user already has a tab open on https://example.org/. Find that existing tab (don't open a new one), take control of it, read its main heading, then give it back to the user without navigating it or closing it.

name: team-both
prompt: Spawn four subagents at the same time with the Agent tool, each with its own browser job, and wait for all of them. A: in Chrome, open https://news.ycombinator.com and report the title of the top story. B: in Helium, open https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Iceland and report the population figure shown in the infobox. C: in Chrome, open https://example.com and report its main heading. D: in Helium, open https://www.iana.org/help/example-domains and report its main heading. Tell each subagent which browser to use and to close its tabs. Report all four answers.

name: scroll-helium
prompt: In the Helium browser: open https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_countries_and_dependencies_by_population, scroll down through the main table, and report which country is ranked 20th and its population figure as shown.
